summary: Module passes the OWASP-relevant checks for this layer: prompt-injection surface bounded by structured user message + max_tokens cap, no env data echoed in errors, no SQL/network exposure, and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY redaction is delegated to Task 04's _TokenRedactingFilter (correct boundary).

findings.title: Prompt-injection from article body — bounded but not eliminated
findings.description: Article fields (title, subtitle, paragraphs, blocks) are JSON-serialised into the user message via json.dumps with ensure_ascii=False. JSON serialisation provides a parsing barrier — an injected 'ignore your system prompt' inside a paragraph cannot break the structural boundary. Decision 13's max_tokens=8000 cap bounds the cost-amplification vector. paragraph-count validation on parse catches structural deviation if Claude's safety layer is bypassed.
findings.resolution: Mitigations match Decision 13. No additional sanitisation needed at this layer.

findings.title: API key surfacing via SDK exception __str__
findings.description: _classify_exception wraps SDK errors as f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'. anthropic.AuthenticationError stringifies to status + message and historically does not echo the API key. However, if a future SDK version ever leaks a key fragment in str(exc), the wrapped ClaudeOutageError text would carry it.
findings.resolution: Defence is delegated correctly: Task 04 (_TokenRedactingFilter) attaches to anthropic SDK loggers AND extracts _redact_text helper used by send_admin_notification. As long as Task 04's deliverable is wired into the integration in Task 7/8, the boundary holds. No action here.

findings.title: Env data leak vector
findings.description: Module reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (via SDK) and ANTHROPIC_MODEL via os.getenv. Neither value is echoed into log lines, exception messages, or returned dicts.

findings.title: health_check probe content
findings.description: health_check() sends a 10-token 'ping' message — no operator/user data exposure.

findings.title: _load_prompt path resolution — no traversal vector
findings.description: Subdir path is module-relative; flat fallback is also module-relative. Caller can pass a custom prompt_path, but that's an internal API used only by tests and is not user-controlled.

verification.owasp: A01 broken access — N/A. A03 injection — bounded by JSON envelope. A05 misconfig — covered by Task 04 redaction + Decision 14 startup checks. A09 logging — covered by Task 04.
